The plate is about 26 cm across, which is roughly 400 px in the photo. The food covers an area of about 12 by 20 cm. It looks like scrambled eggs with spinach, topped with diced fresh tomato.

I estimate about 2 eggs' worth of scramble at roughly 150 g, plus 60 g of diced tomato and a little spinach. That comes to about 220 g total.

Scrambled eggs with some oil or cheese run about 1.6 kcal/g, so 150 g gives about 240 kcal. The tomato adds about 15 kcal and the spinach about 10 kcal. The total is around 270 kcal.
